---
title: pyplatypus
---

The engine behind [platypus](https://maju116.github.io/platypus/): segmentation and object
detection in PyTorch, described by one specification and run from it.

This site documents the Python package. **If you are working in R, read
[the R package's documentation](https://maju116.github.io/platypus/) instead** - it is the
same engine with an R surface on top, and its pages are written for that.

```python
import pyplatypus

spec = pyplatypus.from_yaml("run.yaml")
engine = pyplatypus.build_engine(spec)
engine.fit()
engine.evaluate("validation")
```

The same run as a configuration file:

```yaml
task: semantic_segmentation
data:
  train_path: train/
  validation_path: valid/
  colormap: [[0, 0, 0], [255, 255, 255]]
models:
  - name: unet
    architecture: u_net
    input_shape: [256, 256]
    loss: {name: dice}
    metrics: [{name: iou}]
```

Every field in that file is documented in the reference, generated from the models
themselves - so it cannot describe a format the engine does not have.
